deposits.genre_observed: theoretical paper / protocol specification synthesizing literatures into an accounting framework

finds.quote: We propose *coherence value* as the fifth historical value-form: value constituted not by scarcity, utility, labor-time, or exchange, but by the capacity to produce and sustain meaningful connection between elements of experience.
finds.window: Smith 1776; Marx 1867; Jevons 1871; Menger 1871; twentieth-century economics
finds.note: Historiographical thesis the deposit advances as its own: the history of political economy periodized as successive value-form identifications, with coherence value proposed as the fifth; weak H, largely a framing schema, no stated test.

deposits.incidental: The many 'what it lacks' assessments of prior scholarship (sections I-II, subordination table lines 240-375) are critiques/positioning of the literature rather than historical theses and were not recorded; the Marx/Ricardo analogy (lines 35, 417) is adopted conventional history. Table rows are hard-line-broken one cell per line.

deposits.genre_observed: book sampler: introduction, opening chapter and condensed operations protocol of a heteronym-authored field manual

finds.quote: Four distinct realities crystallized within hours, each internally coherent, each supported by evidence its proponents considered decisive, each producing different conclusions about cause, blame, and remedy. This was not a disagreement about facts. This was a divergence of worlds.
finds.falsifier_quote: Four communities. Four explanations. Four sets of evidence emphasized and four sets ignored. And — the critical point — virtually no productive communication between them.
finds.note: Reception thesis about the FTX collapse: four communities formed incompatible explanations with virtually no productive cross-communication; argued (lines 182-197) as diagnostic case, checkable against the discourse record.

finds.quote: The erosion of these authorities — through genuine failures (Iraq WMDs, the 2008 financial crisis), through deliberate delegitimization campaigns, and through the structural displacement of institutional media by platform-mediated content — has eliminated the shared substrate. Political disagreement is no longer about what to do with shared facts but about what the facts are.
finds.window: most of the twentieth century; Iraq WMDs, the 2008 financial crisis
finds.note: Causal historical thesis on the erosion of shared epistemic authority, advanced as the first of three converging conditions; partly conventional, recorded because argued as the book's own premise.

deposits.incidental: Line 121 (Lee Sharks wrote Pearl and Other Poems in 2014) is internal chronology, not recorded. Line 223 makes a passing claim that moral condemnation of tribalism 'has failed for three decades' (not recorded separately). Repeated '---' separators; no damage observed.
